The nonce-rename false-alarm rate is 0.76. Three vocabulary-robust approaches were tested (name-free alignment, hybrid matching, gloss-gated checking); all reduce correct-candidate divergence but proportionally increase error endorsement, producing no net AUROC gain. The gloss-gated checker failed its development gate (AUROC 0.696 vs 0.742 for plain alignment). This tradeoff between divergence and endorsement appears structural when vocabulary is unconstrained.</li>\n    <li><strong>Error endorsement.</strong> On Dataset E, 38% of errors are endorsed by the majority. The endorsed-error rate is higher for structural errors (57%) than for polarity errors (5%). The PEER+TEXT fusion does not significantly outperform consensus alone (stratified delta +0.011, not significant).</li>\n    <li><strong>Incomplete confirmations.</strong> Confirmation was attempted on three fronts (a fresh 550-sentence test set, a second long-sentence sample, and R_COMP under free vocabulary). All three were budget-stopped before reaching testability. The only confirmed result on an independent test set is the shared-vocabulary long-sentence test. The Dataset E result met its pre-registered criterion but is a development-set estimate.</li>\n    <li><strong>Short-sentence weakness.</strong> The consensus advantage over the judge does not hold on short FOLIO-style sentences (CTRL stratum on Dataset E: &minus;0.069 [&minus;0.23, 0.10]). The method is strongest on long, conditioned sentences where judges struggle with logical complexity.</li>\n    <li><strong>Domain scope.</strong> All evaluation is on FOLIO and MALLS-derived data. import sys, os
```
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

SCRATCH = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PAGE = "file:///ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/index.html"
CHROME = "/usr/bin/chromium-headless-shell"

def shot(page, name, width, height, scroll_y=None):
    page.set_viewport_size({"width": width, "height": height})
    if scroll_y is not None:
        page.evaluate(f"window.scrollTo(0, {scroll_y})")
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    path = os.path.join(SCRATCH, name)
    page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=(scroll_y is None))
    print(f"Saved {path} ({os.path.getsize(path)} bytes)")

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(executable_path=CHROME, args=["--no-sandbox", "--disable-gpu"])
    ctx = browser.new_context()
    page = ctx.new_page()
    page.goto(PAGE, wait_until="networkidle")

    # Full page at phone width
    shot(page, "phone_full.png", 375, 812)
    # Full page at desktop width
    shot(page, "desktop_full.png", 1280, 900)

    # Desktop viewport shots: top, middle, end
    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 1280, "height": 900})
    page.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, 0)")
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    shot(page, "desktop_top.png", 1280, 900, scroll_y=0)

    total_h = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollHeight")
    shot(page, "desktop_mid.png", 1280, 900, scroll_y=total_h // 2)
    shot(page, "desktop_end.png", 1280, 900, scroll_y=total_h)

    browser.close()
    print("Done")
```

```
import json
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

PAGE = "file:///ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_An1uy2kF2SjZ/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/index.html"
CHROME = "/usr/bin/chromium-headless-shell"

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(executable_path=CHROME, args=["--no-sandbox", "--disable-gpu"])
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto(PAGE, wait_until="networkidle")

    # 1. Heading hierarchy
    headings = page.evaluate("""() => {
        return [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6')].map(h => ({
            tag: h.tagName, text: h.textContent.trim().substring(0, 60)
        }))
    }""")
    print("=== HEADINGS ===")
    prev = 0
    for h in headings:
        level = int(h['tag'][1])
        skip = level > prev + 1 if prev > 0 else False
        print(f"  {h['tag']}: {h['text']}" + (" *** SKIP!" if skip else ""))
        prev = level

    # 2. Images without alt text
    imgs = page.evaluate("""() => {
        return [...document.querySelectorAll('img')].map(i => ({
            src: i.src.split('/').pop(), alt: i.alt, hasAlt: i.hasAttribute('alt')
        }))
    }""")
    print("\n=== IMAGES ===")
    for img in imgs:
        status = "OK" if img['hasAlt'] and img['alt'] else "MISSING ALT"
        print(f"  [{status}] {img['src']}: {img['alt'][:80] if img['alt'] else '(empty)'}")

    # 3. Tab order - get all focusable elements
    focusable = page.evaluate("""() => {
        const els = document.querySelectorAll('a[href], button, [tabindex], input, select, textarea');
        return [...els].map(e => ({
            tag: e.tagName, text: (e.textContent || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().substring(0, 50),
            tabindex: e.tabIndex
        }))
    }""")
    print(f"\n=== FOCUSABLE ELEMENTS: {len(focusable)} ===")
    for f in focusable[:10]:
        print(f"  {f['tag']} [{f['tabindex']}]: {f['text']}")
    if len(focusable) > 10:
        print(f"  ... and {len(focusable)-10} more")

    # 4. Landmark elements
    landmarks = page.evaluate("""() => {
        const roles = ['main', 'nav', 'footer', 'banner', 'contentinfo'];
        const found = [];
        roles.forEach(r => {
            const els = document.querySelectorAll(`[role="${r}"], ${r}`);
            if (els.length) found.push({role: r, count: els.length});
        });
        return found;
    }""")
    print("\n=== LANDMARKS ===")
    for l in landmarks:
        print(f"  {l['role']}: {l['count']}")

    # 5. Test lightbox open/close with keyboard
    gallery_items = page.query_selector_all('.gallery-item')
    if gallery_items:
        gallery_items[0].focus()
        page.keyboard.press('Enter')
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        lb_open = page.evaluate("document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.contains('open')")
        print(f"\n=== LIGHTBOX ===")
        print(f"  Opens on Enter: {lb_open}")
        page.keyboard.press('Escape')
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        lb_closed = not page.evaluate("document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.contains('open')")
        print(f"  Closes on Escape: {lb_closed}")

    # 6. Skip link
    skip = page.query_selector('.skip-link')
    print(f"\n=== SKIP LINK ===")
    print(f"  Present: {skip is not None}")
    if skip:
        print(f"  Text: {skip.text_content()}")
        print(f"  href: {skip.get_attribute('href')}")

    browser.close()
    print("\nDone.")
```

````
# Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a Gold-Free Faithfulness Metric for NL-to-Logic Translation

This directory contains the assembled paper and its public-facing web page.

## Layout

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Self-contained public web page (GitHub Pages site) |
| `paper.tex` | LaTeX source of the paper |
| `paper.pdf` | Compiled paper PDF |
| `references.bib` | Bibliography |
| `references.json` | Structured reference data |
| `figures/` | All figures (PDF originals + PNG renders for the web) |
| `workspace/` | LaTeX compilation scratch (ignorable) |

## Running

The web page is a single `index.html` file with no build step and no external dependencies. Open it directly in a browser, or serve with any static file server:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
# then open http://localhost:8000
```

The page references figures via relative paths (`figures/*.png`), so the `figures/` directory must be served alongside it.

## Restoring removed files

The `workspace/` directory contains LaTeX build artifacts and can be regenerated:

```bash
pdflatex paper.tex
bibtex paper
pdflatex paper.tex
pdflatex paper.tex
```
````
